summary: fix(settings): seed a valid uid in MfaGuard story mocks
description:
Because:

* cache.ts ignores stored accounts whose uid isn't 32 hex characters, so
  stories seeding 'abc123' threw "Missing sessionToken" in MfaGuard

This commit:

* Seeds MOCK_UID in the MfaGuard, Security, SubRow, PagePasskeyAdd, and
  UnitRowPasskey story mocks

Closes #FXA-14638
